extensionDescription.message: Yerna ifecka n prompt yettwaseqlen i isebtar n usenqed n YouTube: seqdec askan Standard neɣ Avancée, nɣel asenfar akked uprompt IA yettwafernen s yiwen n usiti, yerna senned prompt-inek deg Yiɣewwaren.

popup_lede.message: Fren amek ara d-iban PromptTube deg isebtar n usenqed n YouTube.

popup_mode_standard_help.message: Isekan-d yiwen n tqeffilt tafessast n usileɣ. Snifel aprompt-nni deg Yiɣewwaren.

popup_mode_advanced_help.message: Isekan-d amsefran ummid n prompts akked merra timudma yellan.

options_lede.message: Snifel prompt yellan deg YouTube, rnu wiyad neɣ err-d azal imezwaruen.

options_section_copy.message: Yal prompt yesra tabzimt d weḍris n uselmed i ara yettwarnun send asenfar.

options_standard_prompt_note.message: Aprompt Agzul yettuseqdac deg uskan Standard u ur yezmir ara ad yettwakkes.

options_standard_prompt_locked.message: Aprompt Agzul yettuseqdac deg uskan Standard u ur yezmir ara ad yettwakkes.

options_storage_unavailable.message: Asekles ulac-it deg umniḍ n yiminig-a.

options_storage_local.message: Asekles adigan kan ara yettuseqdacen. Prompts ur ttusmektayen ara gar iminiggaten.

options_storage_sync_generic.message: Asekles imsinek anida iteddu. Isefka n prompt ilaq ad mseklen gar iminiggaten yettusqedcen s yisem n useqdec i yessefraken async n isiɣzaf.

options_storage_sync_usage.message: Asekles imsinek anida iteddu. Isefka n prompt seqdacen $1 seg tqeddict n usmektay (~100 KB merra deg Firefox).

options_status_load_saved_error.message: Ur izmir ara ad issali prompts yettwaskelsen. Imezwaruyen ttuseknen.

options_status_storage_unavailable.message: Storage API ulac-it. Prompts ur ttwaskelsen ara.

options_status_add_one.message: Rnu ma drus yiwen prompt send asekles.

options_status_save_error.message: Ur izmir ara ad isekles prompts.

options_status_storage_only_page.message: Storage API ulac-it. Imezwaruyen ttuɣalen-d kan deg usebter-a.

options_status_restore_error.message: Ur izmir ara ad d-yerr imezwaruyen.

tip_manage_prompts.message: Tamyart: seqdec tignit n PromptTube akken ad tesferkeḍ prompts

no_transcript_found.message: Ulac asenfar i yettwafkan i uvidyu-a

preset_summary_body.message:
Gzel asenfar-a n YouTube.
Fk-iyi:
- agzul awezlan
- tigejdanin tigejdanin
- taggrayt tameqqrant deg yiwen ubersiḍ awezlan

preset_summary_analysis_body.message:
Gzel u seld asenfar-a n YouTube.
Fk-iyi:
- agzul deg 6 ar 10 n tneqqiḍin
- isental neɣ timsal tigejdanin
- acu i d-yesɛan azal u acuɣer
- tifrat n lqima, ixuṣṣan neɣ tuggiwin yettwabin

preset_summary_actions_body.message:
Gzel asenfar-a n YouTube u kkes-d iḍrisen n uḍfer.
Fk-iyi:
- agzul awezlan
- tigejdanin
- tigawin ibanen
- izraren neɣ iḍfaren i yessefk ad ttuɣalen-d deg ṭṭraǧ

preset_summary_fact_check_body.message:
Gzel asenfar-a n YouTube u creḍ akk ayen i yesra asenqed n tidet.
Fk-iyi:
- agzul awezlan
- timsal tigejdanin
- akk ayen i d-yettbanen d ameḥkuk, d asfeṛfṛi neɣ yesra asenqed
- tabdart tawezzlant n wayen i ilaq ad yettwaseqqed qbel
Syin akkin, eg asenqed n tidet u fk-iyi:
- agzul n wayen i tufiḍ
- anwa timsal i ttwatent, i ttunefkant neɣ i qqiment ur binen ara

preset_executive_brief_body.message:
Err asenfar-a n YouTube d awezlal anedbal.
Fk-iyi:
- tamuɣli tawezzlant n uswir afella
- insight yettawin azal mliḥ
- inigi n tnezzut neɣ n testratejiyat
- imeẓluyen neɣ tillelin tigejdanin

preset_study_notes_body.message:
Err asenfar-a n YouTube d tizmilin n tɣuri.
Fk-iyi:
- agzul yettwasefraken s usentel
- tabadutin neɣ tiktiwin tigejdanin
- isteqsiyen n uɣerbaz neɣ n umeslay yezmer ad d-yili
- asmekti awezlan ara ɣuriɣ s lemɣawla ticki d-yezrin waqit

preset_critique_opportunities_body.message:
Err ɣur-s asenfar-a n YouTube s tikli n tiktiwin.
Fk-iyi:
- agzul awezlan
- acu i d-yesseqnen lqima neɣ tanfult
- acu ixuṣ, id irmi neɣ yettban d amcic
- tiktiwin, tillelin neɣ asnerni i d-yettasen seg-s
